CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID.description: Which space to read. Public because the delivery client needs it in the browser alongside the token below. The name is convention.

CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN.description: Contentful's own API reference repository says delivery tokens are safe for client-side use because they are read-only over published content. That statement comes from Contentful's repository rather than its documentation site.

CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN.description: Reads unpublished content, which is why Contentful says never to expose it in client-side code. Contentful documents no variable name for it, so this one is convention.

CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN.description: Writes. Contentful says it must stay server-side only. There is no rotation in place: create the replacement, move over, then revoke.
